zab lam rdo rje rnal 'byor gyi brgyud pa'i gsol 'debs zhes bya ba bzhugs/dus kyi 'khor lo'i brgyud 'debs zhes bya ba bzhugs/dpal dus kyi 'khor

tei:div.tei:p: zab lam rdo rje rnal 'byor gyi brgyud pa'i gsol 'debs zhes bya ba bzhugs/ .................. . 1 dus kyi 'khor lo'i brgyud 'debs zhes bya ba bzhugs/....... 3 dpal dus kyi 'khor lo'i sgrub thabs rgyas pa dpag bsam ljon shing la 'jug pa zhes bya ba bzhugs/ .............. . 6 dpal dus kyi 'khor lo'i dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga ye shes rgya mtsho'i dgongs don zhes bya ba bzhugs/.... . ....... 100 dpal dus kyi 'khor lo'i bstod pa'am mngon rtogs nye bar bsdus pa bzhugs/..................... 196 bla ma yi dam chos skyong gi bskang gso bde stong rol pa zhes bya ba bzhugs/. ................ 206 dus 'khor tshogs mchod bdud rtsi 'khyil ba zhes bya ba bzhugs/........... . ...... 217 dpal dus kyi 'khor lo'i dga' ston tshogs kyi 'khor lo'i dgyes glu bde chen rdo rje'i gsang tshig zhes bya ba bzhugs/....... 224 dpal dus kyi 'khor lo'i sbyin bsreg gi cho ga nang gi mun sel gyi lag len bzhugs/........ . ......... 228 dpal dus kyi 'khor lo'i dbang chog las rdo rje slob dpon gyi dbang gi cho ga ye shes rgya mtsho la 'jug pa bzhugs/ ......... 239 dpal dus kyi 'khor lo'i dbang gong ma'i cho ga bzhugs/...... 255 dpal dus kyi 'khor lo snying po'i dkyil 'khor gyi sgrub thabs ye shes 'od 'phro zhes bya ba bzhugs/........... 285 dpal sdom pa chen po'i sgrub dkyil gyi rim pa'i khyad par gsal byed bzhugs/......... . ....... 328 dpal dus kyi 'khor lo sdom pa chen po'i dkyil 'khor la bstod pa bzhugs/......... . ........ 387 dus 'khor sdom chen gyi thig tshon gsal byed bzhugs/ ..... 395 dus kyi 'khor lo'i sgrub thabs dang 'grel pa'i phyag rgya'i rnam grangs rab gsal snang ba bzhugs/......... . .... 400- PAGE 2 -- PAGE 1 -
